title: Chainalysis Confirms Security Incident Affecting Internal Tools
excerpt: Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis reported an external intrusion into its internal tools, resulting in the exposure of some customer identity data.
body_html:
Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis has confirmed it was the target of a recent cybersecurity incident involving an intrusion into its internal tools.

According to the company, an external actor gained access to non-sensitive customer data during the breach. However, Chainalysis stated that the unauthorized access did not impact its investigation content, authentication credentials, or session tokens.
